title: My review for utiself
body: I just started using this app today and my first impression was good. The app was easy to install and set up. The inter was simple to navigate. Everything had been working smoothly so far. The only thing I noticed is that some sections took a little time to understand at first, and a few features could be explained more clear for we new users. Overall, it’s been a good experience and I am looking forward to using it more and giving more feedbacks.
